title: Scratchy: Visual-Scratchpad Multimodal Reasoning for Cryptographic Proof Generation in EasyCrypt
abstract: arXiv:2609.06226v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently made substantial progress in formal proof generation, yet presenting distinctive challenges in cryptographic area. Computational security arguments posit that a valid proof must coordinate probability, adversarial games, invariants, assumptions and bounds, which can be provided by a machine-checked framework named EasyCrypt. Although all objects may appear in available context, LLMs still struggle because proof-theoretic dependencies are typically implicit in a linear representation and distributed across multiple programs. So, this paper presents Scratchy, a visual-scratchpad approach that exposes these dependencies for multimodal generation. Given the natural-language security description, with formal context and target propositions, the proof objects can be normalized into a typed proof-relation graph. translated_title: Scratchy：面向EasyCrypt密码学证明生成的视觉草稿纸多模态推理方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）最近在形式化证明生成方面取得了实质性进展，但在密码学领域仍面临独特的挑战。计算安全性论证要求一个有效证明必须协调概率、对抗博弈、不变量、假设和界等因素，这些可以由名为EasyCrypt的机器验证框架提供。尽管所有相关对象都可能出现在可用上下文中，LLMs仍然难以应对，因为证明论依赖关系通常在线性文本表示中是隐式的，并且分布在多个程序之间。因此，本文提出了Scratchy，一种视觉草稿纸方法，用以显式暴露这些依赖关系以支持多模态生成。给定自然语言安全描述、形式化上下文和目标命题，证明对象可以被规范化为类型化的证明关系图。随后，一个结构保持的视觉编译器将该图转换为公式丰富的视觉表示（摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出Scratchy方法，通过将证明对象规范化为类型化证明关系图并经结构保持的视觉编译器转换为丰富的视觉表示，使多模态大语言模型能够显式感知隐式依赖关系，从而更有效地完成EasyCrypt中密码学形式化证明的生成。
